name: Explainer Video
description: Create narrated, captioned 1080p explainer videos with researched scripts, generated b-roll, and supplied screenshots.
author: Damien Bird
coverImageAlt: A sculptural microphone and camera connect research cards to three illustrated story frames and an audio waveform.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: Create a premium editorial illustration that communicates turning researched ideas into a polished narrated explainer video.
Scene/backdrop: A warm paper-toned studio workspace rendered as an elegant miniature set, with abstract research cards and image fragments flowing through a clear visual sequence toward a finished cinematic frame.
Subject: A central sculptural microphone and camera-lens form connected by a ribbon-like timeline to three borderless storyboard scenes; subtle waveform ridges and blank caption bands suggest narration and accessibility without showing any interface or text.
Style/medium: Premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, layered cut paper, matte ceramic forms, subtle translucent acrylic, restrained technical precision, sophisticated rather than playful.
Composition/framing: Exact 16:10 landscape; one strong left-to-right narrative arc; central focal cluster; generous warm negative space; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: Calm, capable, quietly technical; soft directional studio light, refined shadows, reassuring creative momentum.
Color palette: Warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Constraints: No text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding. Avoid photorealistic people, clutter, generic glowing AI brains, and literal software screenshots.
